figures.alt: Pressure-treated deck guardrail with straight top rail, even balusters, and a level
figures.caption: A railing repair starts with the whole guard section: post condition, rail alignment, baluster spacing, and the deck framing that supports it all matter together.

figures.alt: Pressure-treated deck stair framing with a secure landing and handrail post
figures.caption: Stairs and railings meet at high-use connections. Keep the stair run, handrail, landing, and rail post working as one stable exterior assembly.

figures.alt: Deck ledger with flashing, membrane, joist hangers, and exterior fasteners
figures.caption: If a railing is loose because the deck itself is moving or wet, a cosmetic rail repair is not enough. Inspect the larger framing and water-control details before closing the scope.
